findings.title: Ordinary duplicate-key JSON with Unicode escapes is rejected before storage classification
findings.description: Independently reproduced: literal nonreserved duplicate-key JSON remains plain, while Unicode-escaped equivalent raises evidence-duplicate-key. Narrow fail-closed compatibility limitation; no PASS bypass or selected-evidence impact.
findings.suggested_change: Prospective compatibility correction: establish reserved storage identity before enforcing unique keys for storage; add literal/escaped ordinary-data parity coverage.
